difficulty_notes: Symptom needs 4 layers connected: config cache_key_fields names 'currency' while the model attribute is currency_code; keys.cache_key silently renders missing attrs as empty (collapsed key); FX client uses retry(fallback=None) which swallows outages; convert(amount, None) means 'same currency' so EUR passes through unconverted and is labelled with the requested currency, then cached for 300 s. Traps: changing retry() globally breaks best-effort metrics; treating None as an error breaks EUR (no FX needed); removing the fallback without mapping TransientError to RateUnavailable crashes the handler instead of 503; must not drop caching or retries. Regression cases weighted 0.5.
